_comment: Schema-derived provider contract fixtures (seventh external audit, P2: provider mocks must be contract-derived, never invented). Shapes transcribed from the Hetzner Cloud API's documented create-server / get-action / get-server responses. The executor's serde models MUST deserialize these byte-for-byte; the stub serves them verbatim. If the provider's schema changes, update THIS file first — the tests follow it.

list_servers_response._comment: GET /servers?label_selector=<k>=<v> — the documented list shape (a `servers` array of the same server objects). The label reconciliation (eighth audit, P0-DT) filters by the deterministic create label apexmail-dt:<deployment id>; the stub serves THIS shape with its provider-state matches.
